//: Files that may start processes or run code in a new thread. See docs/guides/checks.md (process-starts).

apps/agent-host/scripts/build.ts.reason: Build tooling (pnpm build:sea), run in CI and by hand, never shipped. It starts only Node with --build-sea and, on macOS, codesign, both with fixed arguments on files it wrote to dist/. It never loads a skill.

apps/agent-host/scripts/smoke.ts.reason: Smoke tooling (pnpm smoke:sea), run in CI after the build, never shipped. It starts only the agent host it just built in dist/, with fixed arguments: a fresh temp profile folder with --version, --sandbox-check, or nothing more (to serve, ended by closing its input), and srt's --version through the payload the host unpacked there. It never loads a skill.

apps/agent-host/src/main.ts.reason: The agent host executable's entry point. With createRequire it loads only files of the payload the build embedded, unpacked and checked against their SHA-256 digests: the host's entry, and the manifest's programs (srt's dist/cli.js, which sandbox-srt starts through process.execPath). Any other first argument is not run, so never a skill's scripts.

packages/adapters/git/src/node/run-proce.reason: Starts only git, at the absolute path findGit resolved, with array arguments and no shell. Every call runs hardened: hooks point at an empty folder and no user or system config is read.

packages/adapters/integration-runner/src.reason: The fenced integration runner's process entry. Its one import() loads the integration's entry file named on its command line, which startRunner only accepts inside the integration's folder. Loading a module starts no process, and the runner's Node runs with --permission and no --allow-child-process or --allow-worker, inside its own Sandbox session.

packages/adapters/mcp/src/pinned/login-s.reason: Reads the PATH of the person's login shell once per app start, so the pinned MCP launcher finds npx, uvx and node on macOS, where a desktop app inherits a short PATH. It reads the login profiles only, not .zshrc, so runners set up there (as nvm and fnm usually are) may be missed. It runs only $SHELL from the app's own environment, as an absolute path, with the fixed arguments -l -c and a script that prints PATH, no workspace input, a five-second limit and a 64 KiB output cap. It refuses a SHELL under a skill's scripts/ folder, as written or through a symbolic link, before anything starts.

packages/adapters/mcp/src/stdio/node-pro.reason: Starts the local program of a stdio MCP connector the person trusted, by the absolute path findProgram resolved from the absolute folders of the connector's PATH (never the current folder; on Windows only an .exe), with array arguments, no shell and only the environment the connector builds, in its own process group so stopping it reaches what it started. On Windows it also starts taskkill from the system folder to end the process tree. It refuses a program, argument or folder under a skill's scripts/ folder, as written or through a symbolic link, before anything starts.

packages/adapters/sandbox-host/src/host-.reason: The launcher's session without a fence, for runs the user confirmed (HAL-958 design 4.3). It starts only the absolute path findProgram resolved from the profile's PATH (never the working folder), with no shell and only the profile's variables. HostSession.start refuses a program, argument or folder under a skill's scripts/ folder, as written or through a symbolic link, before it reaches this file.

packages/adapters/sandbox-host/src/progr.reason: Asks an installed program such as claude for its version. It refuses names with a slash and starts only the absolute path findProgram resolved from the absolute PATH folders of the launcher's environment, which no skill sets (never the current folder; on Windows only an .exe).

packages/adapters/sandbox-srt/scripts/wi.reason: CI tooling for the Windows fence proof (HAL-1919), run by hand and by the report-only sandbox-windows job, never shipped. It starts only Node with the srt CLI from this package's node_modules and a child script it writes to a temporary folder, both with fixed arguments. It never loads a skill.

CI tooling for the Phase 5 Windows verdict probes (HAL-3776), run by hand and by the report-only sandbox-windows-spike job, never shipped. It starts Node with the srt CLI from this package's node_modules and child scripts the probes write to a temporary folder, and it runs fixed commands outside srt (PowerShell, wsl.exe, where, icacls, java, go, git, dotnet, curl) as controls on a throwaway runner. Every command is a literal in windows-verdict-probe.mjs or windows-isolation-probe.mjs, which start processes only through this file. It never loads a skill.

CI tooling for the Phase 5 Windows spike (HAL-3775), run by hand and by the report-only sandbox-windows-spike job, never shipped. It starts Node with the srt CLI from this package's node_modules and child scripts it writes to a temporary folder, and it also runs fixed shell commands outside srt (curl, PowerShell, git, npm) as controls on a throwaway runner. Every command is a literal in this file. It never loads a skill.

packages/adapters/sandbox-srt/src/journa.reason: On Windows only, limits the journal folder to the current user (HAL-3896). It starts only whoami.exe and icacls.exe from the system folder, with fixed arguments and the folder the host chose, no shell. It never loads a skill.

packages/adapters/sandbox-srt/src/machin.reason: Probes whether bubblewrap starts and may create user namespaces. It runs only bwrap with fixed arguments.

packages/adapters/sandbox-srt/src/srt-ru.reason: Starts sandbox-runtime's srt with Node to run a session's program inside the fence. srtRunner.run itself refuses a program, argument or folder under a skill's scripts/ folder, as written or through a symbolic link, before anything starts, so no caller gets round it.

packages/adapters/system-node/src/run-pr.reason: Reads the process table with /bin/ps or Windows PowerShell for halonic doctor's resource report.
